notes.title: Testing Patch 05
notes.notes:
Been a number of smaller updates without notes but most of them were bug fixes.

v0.29
- added particle effects to some of the levels
- fixed bugs with paths not opening
- tweaked the jump/collision mechanics to avoid issues
- adjusting small colliders
- fixing bugs with achievements not unlocking
- added pause to map screen
- map screen has a clearer player indicator with current class
- game time stuff was not being added properly
- cleaned up some level tiles in town/alley to make things more clear
